verdict.rationale: Gusto documents a day-one business bank account, provided via Increase Bank, and a Money Dashboard that consolidates cash balance, inflows and outflows. These sit alongside its payroll platform, so the banking leg of consolidation is covered, but only as an early beta. Nothing in the evidence shows spend management or bill pay, which are two of the three point solutions the story names. Missing for 10: spend management (cards/expenses), bill pay, general availability beyond early beta, independent hands-on corroboration.
